title: Spreading a given chart of a fine log stalk
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and let $M\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$ be a fine log structure: it is a log structure as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] admitting etale-local charts by finitely generated integral commutative monoids, without requiring saturation; integral means that the monoid embeds in its group completion. Let $\bar x$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], let $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$ and $M_{\bar x}$ be the geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and let $P$ be a finitely generated integral commutative monoid. Suppose $h:P\to M_{\bar x}$ is a monoid homomorphism and, writing $E=(\alpha h)^{-1}(A^\times)$, the induced homomorphism
$$P\oplus_E A^\times\longrightarrow M_{\bar x},\qquad [p,u]\longmapsto h(p)u$$
is an isomorphism. Here the pushout identifies $e\in E$ with its image $\alpha h(e)\in A^\times$, as in the chart definition [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Then there is an affine pointed etale neighbourhood $(W,\bar w)\to(X,\bar x)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-etale-morphism] and a chart $\widetilde h:P\to M|_W$ whose germ is the specified homomorphism $h$ under the canonical stalk identification $M_{\bar w}\cong M_{\bar x}$.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1 and 3.7(a), printed pp. 69 and 75: the final sentence extending the restriction of a splitting to a chart near the geometric point. This node isolates the fine-log chart-spreading input to that sentence, in the sharp-chart step of the monoidal-resolution ancestry of lem-trf-local-term-locality, proof (1)--(2).

proof.text: Apply the finite-monoid stalk-data lemma to $F=M$, $P$ and the specified $h$. It gives an affine pointed neighbourhood with a homomorphism $\widetilde h:P\to M(U)$ of germ exactly $h$. By fineness choose a chart cover there by finitely generated integral monoids; lift the same geometric point to one member of that cover. Apply the affine-refinement clause of the same lemma on this pointed member. We obtain a locally Noetherian affine $U$ carrying both $\widetilde h$ and a chart $q:Q\to M(U)$. All specified germs are preserved.

proof.text: Put $\beta=\alpha\widetilde h$ and $N=L_U(P,\beta)$. The associated-log universal property gives $f:N\to M|_U$. Its stalk formula identifies $f_{\bar u}$ with $P\oplus_E A^\times\to M_{\bar x}$, $[p,u]\mapsto h(p)u$, which is the hypothesis isomorphism. This inverse fixes units and respects the structure maps because $f$ does.

proof.text: Apply the charted-log-map right-inverse lemma to $f$, $q$ and $\bar u$. After an affine pointed refinement $V$, it supplies $k:Q\to N(V)$ respecting structure maps and satisfying $fk=q$, together with $g:M|_V\to N|_V$ extending $k$, $fg=\mathrm{id}$ and $g_{\bar v}=f_{\bar u}^{-1}$. No finite generation of units or fine chart on $N$ is needed.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1 and 3.7(a), printed pp. 69 and 75: the final sentence extending the restriction of a splitting to a chart near the geometric point. proof.text: Let $\iota:P\to N(V)$ be the canonical generator map. The two monoid homomorphisms $gf\iota$ and $\iota$ have the same marked germ, since $g_{\bar v}=f_{\bar v}^{-1}$. The equality clause of the finite-monoid stalk-data lemma makes them equal on an affine pointed refinement $W$. Restriction compatibility identifies $N|_W$ with $L_W(P,\beta|_W)$. The associated-log universal property now gives $gf=\mathrm{id}_{N|_W}$, while $fg=\mathrm{id}$ persists under restriction. Thus $f$ is an isomorphism, so $\widetilde h|_W$ is a chart. The same restriction compatibility and canonical stalk identifications preserve its germ $h$ on all of $P$. This is the required affine pointed chart.

lean.statement: theorem EtaleLogStructure.exists_affine_chart_of_isStalkChart {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (M : EtaleLogStructure X) (hM : ∀ (Ω' : Type u) [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω'] (t' : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ X), ∃ (V : X.Etale) (_v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t').fiber.obj V) (Q : Type u) (_ : CommMonoid Q) (q : Q →* M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op V)), Monoid.FG Q ∧ Function.Injective (Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of (M := Q)) ∧ M.IsChart V q) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) {P : Type u} [CommMonoid P] (hPfg : Monoid.FG P) (hPint : Function.Injective (Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of (M := P))) (h : P →* M.toEtalePrelogStructure.stalk t) (hh : M.IsStalkChart t h) : ∃ (W : X.Etale) (w : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj W) (hW : P →* M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W)), IsAffine W.left ∧ M.IsChart W hW ∧ (M.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t W w).hom.comp hW = h
